SELECT
  COALESCE(g.geolocation_city, 'Unknown') AS city,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) = 0 THEN 0
       ELSE (COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id), 0)) END AS avg_orders_per_customer
FROM customers c
JOIN geolocation g
  ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY g.geolocation_city
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) > 0
ORDER BY avg_orders_per_customer DESC
LIMIT 1;
